Date September 20 . 19 39

Subject. Dominic Fontana.

Made by. D.F.S. Killingbeck        Forwarded by. R. W. Mac Cale

With reference to the attached letter from
the American Consulate-General, requesting particulars
of an Italian Subject Dominic FONTANA, there is no
record of this person on file at Police Headquarters.
    Enquiries reveal that Fontana, who is a
married man with three children, resided in Shanghai
from 1925 until 1932, during which time he conducted
an export and import business.
    Nothing is known to the detriment of his
character and he has been described as being reliable
and straightforward. He was registered at the
Italian Consulate-General in Shanghai.
    Father E. FONTANA, brother of Dominic Fontana,
has been the subject of Police enquiries on various
occasions in the past and is known as a very shady
character. He is an associate of Jose LIZARRAGA, a
well known local criminal, and has financed many of
Lizarraga's nefarious enterprises, later sharing in
any profits accrued.
    Lizarraga and Father Fontana amassed a
considerable amount of money by removing quantities
of cargo from north of the Soochow Creek during the
local Sino-Japanese hostilities, Lizarraga having
obtained passes from the Japanese military authorities
allowing him to engage in this business.
    Dr. G. COSTANTINI, is an attorney-at-law,
with offices at 25 Rue Chu Pao San. He has no
criminal record, but is generally regarded as a

事由：多米尼克·丰塔纳（Dominic Fontana）。

撰写人：D.F.S. 基林贝克（Killingbeck）        转呈人：R. W. 麦卡尔（Mac Cale）

兹就附呈的美国总领事馆来函而言，该函要求提供意大利籍人士多米尼克·丰塔纳（Dominic FONTANA）的详细情况。警务处总部档案中并无此人的记录。
    经查询获悉，丰塔纳已婚，育有三名子女，于1925年至1932年间居住在上海，在此期间经营进出口生意。
    未发现任何有损其品行之事，据称他为人可靠、正直。他曾在上海意大利总领事馆注册。
    埃内斯特·丰塔纳神父（Father E. FONTANA），系多米尼克·丰塔纳之兄，过去曾多次成为警方调查对象，众所周知是个极不光彩的人物。他是当地知名罪犯何塞·利萨拉加（Jose LIZARRAGA）的同伙，并资助了利萨拉加的许多非法勾当，随后分享由此获得的任何利润。
    利萨拉加和丰塔纳神父在中日局部冲突期间，通过从苏州河以北地区运走大量货物，积累了巨额财富，利萨拉加已从日本军方当局获得通行证，允许其从事此项业务。
    G. 科斯坦蒂尼博士（Dr. G. COSTANTINI）是一名律师，办公地点位于朱葆三路25号。他无犯罪记录，但普遍被认为是一个

DEPARTMENT OF STATE
CONFIDENTIAL

THE FOREIGN SERVICE
OF THE
UNITED STATES OF AMERICA

AMERICAN CONSULATE GENERAL
Shanghai, China, August 21, 1939.

Subject: Activities of Dominic Fontana.

Major E. I. Bourne, M.C.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Sir:

I have the honor to request all the information
which you may suitably furnish me, regarding the
activities of Mr. Dominic Fontana, an Italian subject,
who formerly resided at 764 Rue Bourgeat, Shanghai.
It is reported that Mr. Fontana resided in this city
from 1925 to 1932, that during that period he conducted
his own business dealing in pechak, that his brother,
Father Ernest Fontana, is a director of the Silesian
Mission here in Shanghai, and that he is on friendly
terms with a Dr. Constantini of 25 Rue Chiposan.

Mr. Fontana is now in Hongkong where he has
recently been dealing in scrap iron.

Your assistance in this matter will be greatly
appreciated.

I have the honor to be, Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

〔签名〕

C. E. Gauss
American Consul General

P.A.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE / 10 SEPT. 1939）

事由：多米尼克·丰塔纳的活动。

E. I. 伯恩少校（Major E. I. Bourne, M.C.），
警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

先生：

谨请阁下提供关于意大利籍人士多米尼克·丰塔纳先生活动的一切适宜提供的信息，该人此前居住于上海白尔路764号。据报，丰塔纳先生于1925年至1932年间居住在本市，在此期间经营自己的白菜生意；其兄埃内斯特·丰塔纳神父是上海西里西亚传教会（Silesian Mission）的董事；且他与奇普桑路25号的一位科斯坦蒂尼博士关系友好。

丰塔纳先生目前在香港，近期从事废铁交易。

如蒙协助此事，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

〔签名〕

C. E. 高斯（C. E. Gauss）
美国总领事

P.A.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 处长办公室 / 1939年9月10日）
